Maya R.: short idea: experiment a slim pricing calculator + succinct FAQ tweaks. tie CTA to upcoming pricing webinar. Ben H.: ok. primary goal? trial sign-ups or webinar RSVPs? Maya R.: primary: trial starts. secondary: webinar RSVPs. monitor /pricing bounce and time-on-page. Sara V.: proposed variants: V1 compact estimator (monthly/yearly, small savings badge), V2 compact + committed-discount nudge (CTA: "See committed pricing"). Diego L.: routing: if estimator > $3k/mo then label lead "high-value" and route to sales triage. low-fuss webhook. Maya R.: FAQ changes: collapse long Qs into one-liners + "learn more" links that expand. target 30% fewer accordion rows visible by default. Ben H.: success metrics: +5% trial-starts or +10% webinar CTR over baseline. run until 1k estimator interactions or 10k pageviews. marketing-bot: staging snippet ready:
Diego L.: sample config for eng: {"threshold":3000,"tag":"high-value","webhook":"/hooks/sales-triage"} Sara V.: microcopy options: A) "Estimated monthly cost" B) "Typical spend (estimate)" C) "Approx monthly spend \u2014 customize". prefer C for dropoff. Maya R.: go with C vs A. Diego: lazy-load after hero to avoid LCP impact. Diego L.: noted. will ensure <50ms additional main-thread. Ben H.: tracking: events = calc_open, calc_submit, calc_cta. add lead_tag to payload. Maya R.: I'll draft experiment doc and dashboard layout (buckets by estimate range, lead tags, trial conversion). Sara will push FAQ copy to #docs. marketing-bot: deploy to staging scheduled 2026-09-14T02:00Z. :rocket:
